content.title: Keyboard navigation changes dashboard context in place
content.intent: Prove the sidebar can be operated by keyboard so a focused navigation item becomes active and updates the workspace heading without leaving the current page.
content.technique_notes: Applied the a11y technique because the product requires keyboard operation, visible focus, and accessible headings on rendered surfaces. Chose one representative keyboard-driven context change because the behavior outcome matches pointer-driven activation across items. Risk-gated covering strength was 2 because no money, auth, or data-loss factor applies; no covering array was needed.
